Installation Instructions

  1. Download either:
    • The D2PT hero grid using the main download button
    • A merged hero grid after uploading your own configuration
  2. In Explorer go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\userdata\#YOUR_STEAM_ID#\570\remote\cfg
  3. Backup existing Hero Grids: Rename hero_grid_config.json to hero_grid_config_backup.json
  4. Copy your downloaded JSON file over to the opened folder
  5. Rename it to hero_grid_config.json
  6. Start or Restart Dota 2

Note: The hero grid configuration is updated daily with the latest meta statistics from Dota 2 Pro Tracker. For the best experience, download a fresh copy regularly.

New Merge Feature: Use the upload area at the top of this page to merge your existing hero grid with the D2PT grids. This preserves your custom layouts while adding the meta layouts.
